content_data.meeting_title: IoT Gateway Architecture Review and Q4 Sprint Planning
agenda_items: Review current MQTT broker performance metrics and scalability concerns
Address technical debt in legacy communication protocols
Discuss edge computing implementation for predictive maintenance modules
key_decisions: Implement Redis caching layer to handle increased sensor data throughput from industrial automation clients
Migrate from monolithic architecture to microservices using Kubernetes for improved scalability across European client deployments
